name: Lesaka Technologies, Inc.
source: Lesaka Technologies, Inc. consolidated statements of operations for the year ended 30 June 2026, Form 10-K and Q4 FY2026 earnings release (Nasdaq: LSAK, JSE: LSK). Figures stated in USD thousands in the filing and stored here in USD. Revenue 721,554 less cost of goods sold, IT processing, servicing and support 490,834 equals gross profit 230,720. Operating expenses 218,039 are selling general and administration 153,473 plus allowance for credit losses 12,796 plus depreciation and amortisation 47,346 plus impairment loss 4,035 plus transaction costs 389, which with operating income 12,681 reconciles. Net finance costs 15,617 are interest expense 18,506 less interest income 2,889. Income before income tax expense 3,726 less income tax 1,429 equals 2,297 net profit before equity-accounted investments; adding 215 earnings from equity-accounted investments and removing a 246 non-controlling interest loss gives 2,758 attributable to Lesaka, the basis of the printed basic earnings per share of 0.03. The FY2025 and older columns are the earlier Yahoo Finance basis; the same filing restates FY2025 and the stored FY2025 column is not restated.
reconciliation_note: FY2026 bridges, all from the printed statement: Revenue 721,554 less Cost of goods sold 490,834 equals Gross profit 230,720. Gross profit less Operating expenses 218,039 equals Operating profit 12,681. Operating profit 12,681 less Net finance costs 15,617 gives negative 2,936, and the printed Profit before tax of 3,726 is reached after adding the printed change in fair value of equity securities 2,593, other income 3,883 and reversal of allowance for doubtful loan receivable 1,500 and deducting the printed loss on impairment/disposal of equity-accounted investment 584 and loss on disposal of equity securities 730. Profit before tax 3,726 less Income tax 1,429 equals 2,297 net profit before equity-accounted investments; add 215 earnings from equity-accounted investments for 2,512 net income, then remove the 246 non-controlling interest loss for 2,758 attributable to Lesaka, which is the Net Profit shown and the basis of the printed 0.03 basic earnings per share.
